response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, but his primary expertise lies in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang rather than C++. While he has worked with C++ in the past (e.g., National Instruments), his recent roles and projects predominantly focus on web and mobile development, lacking depth in the core competencies required for this role (e.g., STL, secure industrial cybersecurity standards, or C++-centric architectures). His strengths in agile methodologies and collaboration are notable, but the misalignment in technical focus significantly impacts his overall fit.
strengths: Strong background in software craftsmanship with TDD, CI/CD, and agile practices
Proven ability to work with event-driven architectures and high-performance systems (e.g., low-latency apps, real-time metadata)
Experience in collaborative development, mentorship, and technical documentation
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience and expertise in STL, object-oriented principles, or industrial automation systems
No demonstrated knowledge of IEC 62443-4-1 or secure development lifecycle practices for industrial cybersecurity
Lacks experience with message brokers, multi-threading, or distributed systems in C++-centric environments
